scene: The crawler rattles along its cable toward the churning bridge gears.
beats: You refold her creased blueprint, revealing a shortcut to the bridge's noodle stalls just as the crawler docks.
You wind its tiny key; the bird trills a brass tune, alerting the conductor to slide the exit gate open at Gear Bridge.
He shares oily advice on traversing turning gears, handing you a free wrench ticket as you step onto the platform.
picture: Inside the rattling brass tram car, a level row of rivets runs along the floor. On the far left sits a woman with a large paper map. In the centre, the player stands beside a caged clockwork bird. To the right, a tea-drinking mechanic sits by large floor levers. Outside the rectangular windows, glowing neon signs recede.
